title.why: Own rendering of the Serbian title; no English official text found. Matches the PDF preamble ('СТРАТЕГИЈУ РАЗВОЈА ВЕШТАЧКЕ ИНТЕЛИГЕНЦИЈЕ У РЕПУБЛИЦИ СРБИЈИ ЗА ПЕРИОД 2025-2030. ГОДИНЕ').

original_title.why: Words match the srbija.gov.rs heading (nominative) letter for letter; the record writes '2025–2030' with an en dash while the stored srbija.gov.rs text has a hyphen ('2025-2030') and the PDF text layer drops the dash ('20252030'). The dash glyph cannot be settled from stored text; harmless.

issuing_body.why: Preamble: 'Влада усваја' (the Government adopts) under Art. 38(1) of the Law on the Planning System; initiative of the Ministry, p. 1.

official_identifier.why: p. 61: '05 Број: 011-13287/2024-2', the Government's act number (the Službeni glasnik reference is not stored).

date_published.why: p. 61: 'У Београду, 10. јануара 2025. године' (In Belgrade, 10 January 2025) under the act number, signed for the Government by PM Miloš Vučević; it is the adoption date.

status.why: Strategy is a policy document under Art. 12 of the Law on the Planning System, period 2025-2030, replacing the 2020-2025 strategy (p. 61). No newer act found.

legal_force.why: p. 3: 'представља документ јавне политике' (is a public policy document).

notes.why: Publication order, 7 working days, 90-day action plan (section 10) and repeal of the 2020-2025 strategy (Službeni glasnik 96/19) (section 11, p. 61) match the PDF text.

summary_claims.claim: First of six special objectives is the institutional and legal framework for safe, secure, trustworthy and responsible AI
summary_claims.locator: p. 25, special objective 1: 'Стварање и усклађивање институционалног и правног оквира за развој и сигурну, безбедну, поуздану и одговорну примену вештачке интелигенције' (creating and aligning the institutional and legal framework for the development and safe, secure, trustworthy and responsible application of AI)

summary_claims.claim: General objective: trustworthy and responsible AI for growth, jobs and quality of life
summary_claims.locator: p. 25: 'Употреба поуздане и одговорне вештачке интелигенције у функцији економског раста, запошљавања и квалитетнијег живота'

summary_claims.claim: The law is to be adopted and fully applied by the end of 2027
summary_claims.locator: pp. 26-27: indicator 'Циљна вредност за крај 2027. године: Пуна примена Закона о вештачкој интелигенцији' (full application of the Law on AI); Measure 1.1 'Усвојен закон ... за крај 2027: Да'

summary_claims.claim: Risks reviewed: privacy, algorithmic bias, misuse, inequality, lack of clear regulation, energy
summary_claims.locator: p. 5-6 (Introduction): 'пристрасности у алгоритмима', 'повећати неједнакости', 'Недостатак јасних регулација', 'енергетске'

summary_claims.claim: Positions Serbia against the EU AI Act
summary_claims.locator: Intro describes the EU act as the first comprehensive law; p. 26 'Правни оквир мора бити усклађен са европским' (the legal framework must be aligned with the European one). 'Positions against' is loose; 'in relation to' would be tighter.

scope.note: National AI strategy whose main content is development, education, infrastructure and adoption; its first special objective is a legal and institutional framework for the safe, secure and responsible application of AI, and it reviews AI risks. Included under the inclusive rule for strategies with some safety content.

note: All checked summary and notes claims match the Serbian text, with my own translations in summary_claims. Scope: the strategy is mainly about development, education, infrastructure and adoption, with a legal framework objective, so it is borderline by the letter of under section 10 and should carry a scope_note; few of the register's 49 strategies carry one, so a human may prefer to keep it as core. The only wording issue is the dash in original_title and 'positions Serbia against' in the summary. One search found no AI law adopted yet and no newer strategy; the Službeni glasnik reference stays unconfirmed.
